title: Specify voice workspace wiring: busy teammate elsewhere, switched conversation
description: The voice routing is specified in features/web_voice_control.feature through a tsx harness, but EnabledWorkspace's voice wiring is not: (1) a line to a teammate whose turn is running in a conversation that is not open is held (server getActiveTurn check), (2) a line is not sent when the member switched conversations while it was opening, (3) a failed busy lookup holds the line. Move the decision into a pure function the harness can drive, or add a component-level harness. From PR #385 review.
